name: io.github.travisjmurphy/x402-safe-wallet
title: x402 Safe Wallet
description: Testnet-first capped wallet for bots paying x402 APIs: receipts, idempotency, fail-closed checks.

environmentVariables.name: X402SW_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Private directory for the wallet key, config and receipts (default ~/.x402-safe-wallet). Created with mode 700.

environmentVariables.name: X402SW_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: key of a DEDICATED wallet holding only what you can lose. If unset, the key file in X402SW_HOME is used.
